title: Types of Duty
outcomes: Explain BCD, IGST, SWS and AIDC on imports.
Apply safeguard measures and emergency powers.
Compute total customs duty on imports.

meta.exam_tip: Keep two bases separate: SWS excludes trade-remedy duties; the IGST base includes them.

concepts.title: Basic customs duty, IGST and surcharges
body: BCD is levied under section 12 of the Customs Act at rates in the First Schedule (imports, 8-digit, HSN-aligned) or Second Schedule (exports, a short list). Preferential rates apply to imports from notified areas if the importer claims them and proves origin under rules of origin; otherwise the standard rate applies.

IGST under section 3(7) of the Customs Tariff Act applies at the rate on like goods supplied in India (cap 40%), on assessable value plus BCD and other customs duties, excluding IGST itself. GST compensation cess under section 3(9) has been phased out. For warehoused goods sold before clearance, IGST value is the higher of that value and the last transaction value.

Social welfare surcharge is 10% of aggregate customs duties, excluding safeguard duty, CVD, anti-dumping duty and SWS itself; IGST is exempt from SWS. AIDC is levied on specified goods at notified rates. Additional duty under section 3(1) now matters mainly for petroleum and tobacco.
concepts.analogy: Layers of duty, each with its own base.

concepts.title: Safeguard measures and emergency powers
body: Sections 8 and 8A give emergency power to raise export or import duty by notification. Section 8B lets the Government impose safeguard measures — duty, tariff-rate quota or other measures — where increased imports cause or threaten serious injury to the domestic industry.

Safeguard measures last up to 4 years, extendable while the industry adjusts, but not beyond 10 years in total. A provisional measure may last up to 200 days. Tariff-rate quotas ordinarily keep imports at least at the average of the last three representative years.

Exclusions: a developing country with import share not exceeding 3%, provided such countries together do not exceed 9%. Imports by EOU/SEZ units are excluded unless cleared into DTA, when duty applies on the portion cleared.
concepts.analogy: Safeguards protect against surges, regardless of fairness of trade.
concepts.work: A sudden import surge of solar glass can trigger a safeguard duty.

concepts.title: Countervailing and anti-dumping duties
body: Section 9 allows countervailing duty on subsidised imports, capped at the subsidy amount; section 9A allows anti-dumping duty, capped at the margin of dumping (normal value less export price) and in practice the lower of dumping margin and injury margin. Both apply irrespective of other duties and may be provisional.

Both duties last 5 years unless revoked, extendable by up to 5 years on review. Retrospective levy is possible in case of massive dumping or subsidisation causing hard-to-repair injury, but not beyond 90 days before the provisional duty notification.

Section 9B: the same article cannot bear both CVD and ADD for the same situation; no levy merely because of exemption from domestic taxes on exports; provisional duties are restricted for WTO members unless injury is found. Appeals lie to the CESTAT Special Bench within 90 days under section 9C with a fee of ₹15,000.
concepts.analogy: Unfair trade remedies need proof of subsidy or dumping plus injury.
concepts.work: An exporter selling at ₹500 when home price is ₹600 is dumping by ₹100.

concepts.title: Computing total import duty
body: Sequence for computing duty: assessable value; BCD on assessable value; SWS on BCD (and other duties in its base); safeguard, CVD or ADD as applicable; IGST on assessable value plus all customs duties.
ADD, CVD and safeguard duty enter the IGST base but stay out of the SWS base.
Registered importers may take ITC of IGST paid on imports; BCD, SWS and ADD are costs.
concepts.work: Importer's ITC covers IGST but not BCD.

illustrations.title: Total duty with anti-dumping duty
illustrations.q: Orbit Glassware imports 1,000 units with assessable value ₹10,00,000. BCD is 10%, SWS 10%, IGST 18%. The export price is ₹500 per unit against a normal value of ₹600; the injury margin is ₹70 per unit. Compute total duty and IGST.

viva.q: How far back can anti-dumping duty be imposed?
viva.model: Up to 90 days before the provisional duty notification, in case of massive dumping.

viva.q: When does a preferential rate apply?
viva.model: When the importer claims it and proves origin from a notified preferential area under origin rules.

cases.title: Subsidised steel imports
cases.case: An exporting government pays a subsidy of ₹40 per kg on steel exported to India; Indian producers suffer injury.

mcqs.explain: Subsidy remedy. In practice: DGTR inquiry.
Capped at subsidy. In practice: lesser if adequate.

mcqs.q: Can ADD also be levied for the same situation?
mcqs.explain: Section 9B. In practice: avoid double remedy.

mcqs.q: Is CVD included in the SWS base?
mcqs.explain: Excluded. In practice: included in IGST base.
